_comment: Demo roles for the local web page. Each token is stored as its SHA-256; the demo tokens themselves (demo-admin, demo-courier-ops, demo-ksa, demo-analyst) are public and listed in web/index.html so the role picker can send them. Replace every token before using this anywhere real. Row filters are trusted SQL conditions written by whoever owns this file; their parameters are the requester's attributes, written :_user_<attribute>, and come from the token, never from the model.

courier_ops._comment: Runs deliveries: orders, couriers and warehouses, nothing about customers or products.

ksa_manager._comment: Every table, but only rows for their own country: orders shipped from its warehouses, and its customers.

row_filters.orders: warehouse_id IN (SELECT warehouse_id FROM warehouses WHERE country = :_user_country)

analyst._comment: Every table and row, but never who a customer is.
